testsAdded: measures a first painted 300x150 frame as 2:1 although the canvas never changed size
updates the ratio after each paint when the stream changes size mid-way
keeps the same state object for an unchanged or invalid size
never lets a card with another frame id inherit the previous ratio
renders the fallback ratio before the first paint
follows chat resizes with the height cap and disconnects on unmount
openQuestions: The floating (dragged) deck caps its stage at min(--live-fit-stage, 50vh) instead of the measured half-chat height, because the drag fitter measures natural height in the same ResizeObserver cycle before React applies a new cap and would pin a stale value; the docked card uses the measured half-chat cap.
Stage width stays at the full card width; frames taller than the cap are letterboxed with object-fit contain rather than narrowing the tile.
